name: Roasted Halloumi, Lentils and Sweet Potato Traybake

components.name: Halloumi & Sweet Potato Traybake

ingredients.name: Raw sweet potatoes peeled and cubed
Packaged halloumi with vegetarian rennet, diced

steps: Toss peeled sweet potatoes, peppers and red onion with oil and spices, spread on a large tray and roast for 20-25 minutes.
Add diced halloumi to the tray and roast a further 12-15 minutes until cheese takes colour and vegetables are tender.
Portion lentils under roasted vegetables and halloumi into four containers, with sauce packed separately.
Freeze the lentils and sweet potatoes if desired; halloumi can become tough after freezing and reheating, and yogurt dressing should remain chilled.

components.name: Lentils
steps: Heat oven to 210 C. Rinse dry lentils and simmer in water until tender but intact, about 25-35 minutes; drain remaining water.

components.name: Yogurt Dressing
steps: Mix yogurt, lemon and herbs into a cold dressing; keep refrigerated.
